prompt: Rank the drivers of the largest forecast variance.

results.text: EMEA Funding Ltd. in EUR shows the largest forecast variance this period at USD -25.4 million (actual below forecast), driven almost entirely by the delayed inbound settlement. Every other entity is within USD 1.5 million of forecast.

sql.command:
SELECT entity_id, currency, forecast_net_flow_usd, actual_net_flow_usd, forecast_variance_usd
FROM aa_liquidity_variance
ORDER BY ABS(forecast_variance_usd) DESC LIMIT 5
